check_css_code.description: Check CSS you provide, pasted in or made in an earlier step, with W3C's CSS Validation Service: whether it is valid for the CSS level you choose, and each error and warning with its line and selector.

parameters.description: The CSS to check, as it would be in a style sheet. Line numbers in the results count from its first line.

parameters.name: css

parameters.description: The kind of device the CSS is for, as in an @media rule. All media checks it for every device.

parameters.description: How many warnings to report: things that are valid but may not work as expected, such as a font list with no generic family.
parameters.name: warning_level

parameters.description: The most messages to list, errors first. The counts always cover the whole report.
parameters.name: max_messages

message_count.description: How many messages are listed in messages
